ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly white central lobes bounded by a thick black perimeter along the trailing edge and peduncle; dense black mottling (focal spots) concentrated on the inner left lobe; sparse black spotting on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 92 degrees relative to the lobe intersection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude pixel variations (1-5 pixels); significant textured protrusion on the superior margin of the distal left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a convex sweep terminating in a rounded tip; right lobe follows a linear, tapered trajectory terminating in a sharp, thin point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of dark circular pixel clusters (mottling) on the white background of the left lobe; distinct white/textured high-contrast clusters on the black far-left tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical dark pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the central-left lobe and mid-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rough-textured barnacle colonization clusters on the distal tip and upper margin of the left lobe; irregular pigmentation/scarring at the central peduncle base.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetry in lobe surface area, with the left lobe possessing significantly greater pixel-width and vertical expansion than the right lobe.
